# Konstantin Ruge

> Konstantin Ruge is a Fractional CTO & Freelance AI Product Engineer based in Hamburg, Germany. He helps early-stage startups build and ship product — from the first line of code to leading engineering. He runs cobuild (https://cobuild.digital), a product studio for SaaS founders.

## Services

- Fractional CTO: part-time technical leadership for startups — product architecture, engineering hiring, roadmap decisions, hands-on code.
- Freelance AI product engineering: TypeScript, React, Next.js.
- MVP development for early-stage startups.
- Larger product builds run through his product studio, cobuild GmbH (Hamburg).

He works remotely with startups across Europe. Engagements are ongoing part-time or project-based.
